in_marathi.name: Sadab
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sadab हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sadab is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sada' which means 'eternal' and 'Bha' which means 'moon'. The name Sadab thus means 'eternal moon'.

in_bengali.name: Sadab
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sadab একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Sadab is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sada' which means 'eternal' and 'Bha' which means 'moon'. The name Sadab thus means 'eternal moon'.
